name: jira
title: Jira
description: The issues one JQL query matches on a Jira Cloud site, as a table: key, status, assignee and the rest, one row per issue.

site.label: Site
site.hint: Your Jira Cloud site's address. Watching several sites? Add one source per site.

jql.label: JQL
jql.placeholder: project = PROJ order by updated DESC
jql.hint: Which issues to read. Defaults to every issue the account can see, most recently updated first.
